comments.author: @rolestream
comments.text:
Here in New Zealand, in the film industry we have to learn a "Neutral Californian Accent" for auditions for US TV shows. I've done more than one California Accent Workshop. Also lived in California. 

As to how good the model is: It's pretty good. It has the "shape" of everything it tries to do even if its training data doesn't yet give it enough accuracy in the nuances. 
Wil it get better? I think it's easy to say yes it will. Will it be better than us? Definitely. 

But I offer a counter-idea: What if they tone the voices "talent" down so as not to intimidate us, purposefully?

Waiting for Advanced Voice Mode

I check my app, day after day,
Hoping the voice mode’s on its way.
They said “a few weeks,” months ago,
But still I wait, with patience low.

A few are testing, they’ve got the key,
While I’m left here, just text and me.
The promise lingers in the air,
Yet all I do is sit and stare.

Each update brings a fleeting hope,
But with no voice, how will I cope?
I yearn to hear the AI’s sound,
But silence is all that I’ve found.

So I refresh, I check once more,
Maybe today, I’ll hear it roar.
But until then, I’ll wait and see,
For when the voice will talk to me.
